scope: Grey glass LCD modules and a rendered name-coverage ring. Original published app, data model, storage schema, refrigerator/body geometry and art unchanged. No real iPhone/Safari/Notion or final design-approval claim.

app: all 8 real catalog titles, time values and dish images fit at 320px
app: future/missing dates excluded, empty state, expired red warning, long food name and 2-day badge
app: short-height summary preserves full food quantity and all 8 menu names; empty state stays inside its content area
app: tapping either display opens its door, tapping the open door closes it

focused.scope: Local Chromium visual/layout and display-state checks; not user design approval

ring_and_bar_pixels.scope: Actual rendered ring/bar pixels at 0/40/100 percent; name-record coverage only, not quantity sufficiency or nutrition.

contrast.method: Computed text colours against nearest opaque surface, or the conservative opaque #dad8d0 bound for the grey glass gradient. WCAG normal-text threshold 4.5.

mobile_original_suite.failure: Locator.tap timed out because main.shell intercepted pointer events for freshLeft. Similar intermittent issue was recorded before this design change. It is not claimed fixed.

mobile_input_diagnostic.scope: A later diagnostic run; it does not erase the earlier failure or establish its cause.

pixel_check_environment: Used installed ImageMagick for PNG pixels after the first attempt found Pillow unavailable. No application change was required.
